method: deterministic repository review across product, pedagogy, science, UX, privacy, operations, provenance, and maintainability

decision.rationale: The refrigerator baseline is coherent, bounded, accessible, private, deterministic, and operationally fail-closed across all required internal perspectives. External participant observation is optional research and is not a roadmap gate.
authorized_next_work: select and scope a second system route
extract reusable route architecture without destabilizing refrigerator
prototype the second route against the same canonical-content and trust boundaries
extend Atlas only when the selected route requires new exact-revision evidence
not_authorized: silently weaken privacy, provenance, or deterministic-build boundaries

perspectives.summary: The product has a clear learner-facing value proposition, one complete end-to-end route, explicit boundaries, and a separable trust substrate.
strengths: one coherent Observe-Map-Model-Diagnose-Redesign journey
canonical content remains authoritative
refrigerator can remain a stable baseline while planning the next route
perspectives.residual_risk: A second route may expose hidden refrigerator-specific assumptions in the product architecture.
perspectives.next_action: Use the second route to test reuse rather than adding more readiness abstractions.

perspectives.summary: The interaction sequence requires prediction, mechanism, model interpretation, diagnosis, evidence boundaries, and trade-off reasoning rather than passive reading.
strengths: prediction is required before model execution
diagnosis requires an explicit choice before feedback
learner notes and reasoning state persist only in the active tab
perspectives.residual_risk: Internal inspection cannot establish comprehension, retention, transfer, or engagement outcomes.
perspectives.next_action: Preserve the mechanism-first sequence and compare its implementation across the second route.

perspectives.summary: The route uses a bounded thermal model, makes assumptions and limitations visible, and separates model output from real-system conclusions.
strengths: model direction and visible numerical precision are deterministic
limitations are exposed beside the model
evidence status is not treated as proof of a physical conclusion
perspectives.residual_risk: A minimum model can still be overgeneralized if future route copy weakens the current boundary language.
perspectives.next_action: Require each future route to name assumptions, useful scope, and failure conditions.

perspectives.summary: Learner, facilitator, and Pilot Lab surfaces provide keyboard access, visible focus, named controls, live error recovery, accessible tables, and described dynamic graphics.
strengths: choice errors identify and focus the correction target
dynamic thermal results include SVG title and description
loading and failure states disable inert interactions
perspectives.residual_risk: Static and harness-based coverage cannot represent every browser and assistive-technology combination.
perspectives.next_action: Reuse the same accessibility contracts in the second route and add targeted regression tests for new interactions.

perspectives.summary: The product is local-first, has no accounts or analytics, avoids browser persistence, binds only to loopback, and fails closed on untrusted host or asset conditions.
strengths: exact loopback Host validation
no-store, CSP, framing, resource-isolation, and permissions headers
no automatic upload or repository mutation
perspectives.residual_risk: Optional free-text exports can still contain sensitive text if an operator enters it.
perspectives.next_action: Keep free text optional, local, and outside repository authority.

perspectives.summary: Builds are deterministic, runtime identity is hash-bound, launchers fail closed on drift, and initialization and clipboard failure paths recover explicitly.
strengths: deterministic package verification
build-bound local launcher and recorder
focused JavaScript, Python, runtime, smoke, and clean-repository CI
perspectives.residual_risk: The current package remains a local alpha rather than a hosted multi-user service.
perspectives.next_action: Prove route reuse before introducing hosting, accounts, or production infrastructure.

perspectives.summary: Canonical Principia sources and exact-revision Atlas references remain separate, explicit, advisory, and locally packaged.
strengths: no live Atlas dependency
no status inheritance
canonical source extraction is deterministic
perspectives.residual_risk: A new route may need evidence entities not present in the accepted Atlas baseline.
perspectives.next_action: Expand Atlas only from a concrete next-route evidence requirement.

perspectives.summary: The repository has explicit authority files, bounded workflows, extensive regression coverage, and a clear rule against recursive readiness work without product need.
strengths: current product authority is separate from historical phase history
changes are protected by focused CI
GitHub issues are not required for execution
perspectives.residual_risk: Governance documents can become stale when implementation moves quickly.
perspectives.next_action: Keep one concise current-state authority and update it only for material product decisions.

may_claim: tested accessibility, privacy, and security contracts
